intro.text: An Elantrian, once a plantation labourer who hoped to become an apprentice, recruited by Raoden in Elantris.

items.text: Before the Shaod, Riil worked on a plantation and studied alongside the journeymen in hopes of being taken on as an apprentice.

Raoden valued Riil's mix of intelligence, sturdy build and work ethic. He set Riil, Maare and Mareshe to work out how to make a roof from what little they had, then to put it over one of the larger buildings Raoden's people used.
